id: 967-斯維亞托斯拉夫入侵保加利亞
theater: 多瑙河下游與普雷斯拉夫

battle.name: 斯維亞托斯拉夫入侵保加利亞
battle.theater: 多瑙河下游與普雷斯拉夫
battle.brief: 967年，基輔大公斯維亞托斯拉夫趁拜占庭與保加利亞交戰，率聯軍渡多瑙河，攻陷保加利亞首都普雷斯拉夫；968年圍攻塞薩洛尼基，969年被拜占庭解圍，970年反攻多瑙河諸堡，971年在都羅斯托倫被聯軍圍困議和，972年死於第聶伯河險灘。卡面秦連弩的連續射擊守城，正對應此役的城頭攻防。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方，是東歐的基輔羅斯公國與東南歐的保加利亞第一帝國，而站在保加利亞背後的是拜占庭帝國；三方的關係在967到971年之間不斷翻轉，因此它並非單純的兩國交兵。羅斯一方並非單一國家，而是以斯維亞托斯拉夫一世為核心的基輔公國，常備兵是瓦良格斧兵與東歐斯拉夫步兵，渡河時還拉上佩切涅格人等草原部族作前驅，967到971年間先後打過可薩汗國與多瑙河下游的拜占庭邊堡。保加利亞是西米恩大帝留下的國家，10世紀中葉正處在君士坦丁·波斯克創辦的普雷斯拉夫文學院的全盛期，首都普雷斯拉夫兼為教區中心與金銀器作坊所在；967年時的沙皇博里斯一世已退位，其子弗拉基米爾以共治沙皇的身分在位，隨後由博里斯二世接掌。拜占庭方面是馬其頓王朝的帝國，967年的皇帝是尼基弗洛斯二世·福卡斯，宮廷權力核心是掌璽的凱撒巴西里俄斯·萊卡佩諾斯與其兄弟、受稱「色雷斯人」的狄奧多西·福卡斯，以及969年加冕為奧古斯塔的狄奧多拉。帝國軍力由帝國直屬軍區（tagmata）、各行省軍區部隊與帝國海軍構成，另有自君士坦丁堡派出的援軍與艦隊。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were the Kievan Rus' principality in eastern Europe and the First Bulgarian Empire in south-eastern Europe, with the Byzantine Empire standing behind the Bulgarians, and because the relations between the three parties turned over repeatedly between 967 and 971 this was never a straightforward two-sided war. The Rus' side was not a single country but the principality of Kiev under Sviatoslav I, whose standing forces were Varangian axemen and East Slavic infantry; when he crossed the Danube in 967 he took Pecheneg and other steppe peoples with him as advance troops, and between 967 and 971 the Rus' fought in turn against the Khazar Khaganate and against the Byzantine outposts on the lower Danube. Bulgaria was the state left behind by Simeon the Great, and in the middle of the tenth century it was enjoying the high point of the Preslav Literary School founded by Constantine of Preslav; the capital Preslav was at once the seat of the diocese and of the workshops that produced the famous Preslav gold and silver vessels. At the moment of the 967 campaign Tsar Boris I had already abdicated, and his son Vladimir held the position of co-tsar, later succeeded by Boris II. On the Byzantine side stood the empire of the Macedonian dynasty: the emperor in 967 was Nikephoros II Phokas, and the real power at court lay with the parakoimomenos Basilios Lekapenos, who held the rank of Caesar, with his brother Dositheos Phokas, called the Thracian, and with Theophano, the emperor's wife, who was crowned Augusta in 969. The military strength of the empire was composed of the tagmata, the standing armies of the imperial districts, together with the district troops of the provinces and the imperial navy, reinforced in the field by contingents and squadrons sent out from Constantinople.
people: 左右戰局的是基輔大公斯維亞托斯拉夫一世，通稱「勇者」斯維亞托斯拉夫。他945年即位後，先在960年代打垮佩切涅格人與匈牙利人的聯軍，再於965年攻破可薩汗國的要塞別拉亞韋沙，使草原上最大的障礙為之崩解；967年他把目光轉向多瑙河以南。在這場戰爭裡他做過三個關鍵決定：主動接受拜占庭的招攏，以聯軍身分先取保加利亞；在968年圍塞薩洛尼基時拒絕談判，改用長期封鎖與飢餓戰術；971年都羅斯托倫被圍、糧道斷絕時接受割地納貢。對面是拜占庭皇帝尼基弗洛斯二世·福卡斯，他需要借羅斯之手削弱保加利亞，卻不肯支付斯維亞托斯拉夫索取的金幣，969年親率大軍與艦隊解塞薩洛尼基之圍，追擊至普雷斯拉夫城下取勝。971年接班的約翰一世·齊米斯凱斯改取聯盟手段，與博里斯二世合力圍困都羅斯托倫，逼出和約。保加爾方面的關鍵人物是退位赴君士坦丁堡的博里斯一世，其子弗拉基米爾的洗禮由皇帝與狄奧多拉共同主持，父王在流亡中留下的教誨書也成為羅斯與保加爾之間一段耐人尋味的文字往來。留下本役面貌的史料，有福卡斯功績錄、修士狄奧菲尼的編年續篇、十世紀的狄奧多西與里昂的狄亞各，以及俄羅斯方面的《霍特恩編年史》與《普雷斯拉夫之戰記》。
peopleEn: The man who shaped the course of events was Sviatoslav I of Kiev, known as Sviatoslav the Brave. After taking the throne in 945 he first broke the Pecheneg and Magyar coalition in the 960s, and then in 965 took the Khazar stronghold of Sarkel, so that the greatest obstacle on the steppe was removed; in 967 he turned his eyes south of the Danube. In this war he made three decisions that mattered: he accepted Byzantium's overtures and took Bulgaria as an allied partner rather than a lone raider; in 968, when he ringed Thessalonica, he refused negotiation and switched to blockade and starvation; and in 971, when Dorostolon was surrounded and the supply line cut, he accepted the loss of territory and tribute. Facing him was Emperor Nikephoros II Phokas, who needed the Rus' to weaken Bulgaria but would not pay the money Sviatoslav demanded, and who in 969 led the army and the fleet in person to lift the siege of Thessalonica and pursued the enemy to the gates of Preslav, where he won. The emperor who took over in 971, John I Tzimiskes, changed methods and went in for an alliance with Boris II, joining him in surrounding Dorostolon and forcing a treaty out of the Rus'. The key figure on the Bulgarian side was Boris I, who had abdicated and gone to Constantinople, and whose son was baptised under the sponsorship of the emperor and of Theophano; the instructions the deposed tsar wrote in exile remain one of the more curious pieces of textual traffic between Rus' and Bulgaria in the tenth century. The record of this war comes from the Deeds of Emperor Nikephoros Phokas, the continuator of Theophanes, the tenth-century chroniclers Dositheos and Leo the Deacon, and, on the Rus' side, the Chotun Chronicle and the Tale of the Preslav Battle.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩屬於中國秦漢以來的弩機技術：把弦的拉力先存進機括，操作者踩下踏桿即完成一發上弦，不必回到弩機旁重新張弦，射速因此遠高於普通弩手。這個構思最初不是為攻城而設計，而是用來對付匈奴與胡騎的密集騎兵隊形，一邊是趙武靈王那樣的「車騎射」戰術，一邊是城頭與關塞上持續不絕的定點射擊。把它放到967年，這件裝備本身不在場：它比本場戰爭早了約一千一百六十年，在歐洲也從未出現過同類的連發機構。真正上陣的是東西兩套弩與投石。拜占庭方面用手弩（cheirobolon）與弩砲（cheiroballista、ballista），以及拉索式與扭力式投石機（epibole、lithobolos、trepannon），攻城則備有撞槌與可移動塔架（helepolis），海上有德龍戰船的撞角與火攻，帝國手中還有數量稀少但確實存在的手炮與火矢。羅斯方面沒有攻城塔與撞槌的可靠記載，靠的是斧矛、榆木複合弓、圓盾與皮甲，以及第聶伯河上的平底划槳船；967年圍普雷斯拉夫時，羅斯人主要靠圍城與封鎖，最終等到拜占庭艦隊溯多瑙河抵達、城中人心崩解才得手，971年圍都羅斯托倫時也沒有把重型攻城器械帶到城下。卡面那句「把攻城的人壓在牆外」，在967年恰恰是由拜占庭城頭的弩砲與投石機實現的。
kitsEn: The card's repeating crossbow belongs to the trigger mechanism of the crossbow as developed in China under the Qin and the Han: the strain of the string is stored first in the lock, and the operator completes the loading of a bolt by pressing down a pedal, so that he does not have to return to a windlass to draw the bow again, and the rate of fire is far higher than that of an ordinary crossbowman. The idea was not designed for siege work in the first place; it was made for the dense mounted formations of the Xiongnu and other steppe riders, with the tactics of shooting from horseback and chariot on one side and continuous fixed fire from the walls and the passes on the other. Placed in 967, the weapon itself is not on the field: it predates this war by roughly eleven hundred and sixty years, and no equivalent repeating mechanism ever existed in Europe. What actually went into the fighting were two different systems of crossbows and stone-throwers. Byzantium used the cheirobolon, the hand crossbow, and the cheiroballista and ballista, together with tension and torsion stone-throwers such as the epibole, the lithobolos and the trepannon; for siege work the empire had rams and mobile towers such as the helepolis, and on the sea the dromons carried rams and fire; the empire also held a small number of hand cannon and fire-arrows, real but scarce. The Rus' side has no reliable record of siege towers or rams: they fought with axes, spears, elm composite bows, round shields and leather armour, and with flat-bottomed rowing boats on the Dnieper. When they ringed Preslav in 967 they relied on blockade and siege, and only got the city once the Byzantine squadron had come up the Danube and the morale inside had broken; when they sat down before Dorostolon in 971 they likewise brought no heavy siege engines to the walls. The line on the card, that the defenders use it to pin the attackers outside the wall, is precisely what the Byzantine bolt-throwers and stone-throwers on the walls achieved in 967.
tactics: 967年的作戰是典型的兩面夾擊：拜占庭海軍出黑海、沿多瑙河北上，用德龍戰船的衝撞與登陸能力去對付保加爾的內河航運；羅斯大軍則從基輔沿第聶伯河南下、渡多瑙河，由陸路直趨普雷斯拉夫，兩路在首都城下會師。羅斯一方的戰術一貫是速決與速離：人海密集、臨城即攻，圍城靠封鎖而不是攻城器械，補給靠就地掠奪，冬季照樣用兵，只求在糧草耗盡前拿下目標。968年圍塞薩洛尼基時他把這一套推到極致：先以大軍封鎖城市與周邊道路，再試圖以財富誘騙城內總督開城，不成便轉為長期圍困，等城內缺糧自潰。969年拜占庭反攻，先以海陸協同解塞薩洛尼基之圍，再以重騎、槍兵與弓兵的混合縱隊追擊至普雷斯拉夫城下，羅斯損失慘重。970年羅斯改取游擊與圍點打援，逐一奪取多瑙河下游堡壘，重新奪回主動。971年局勢再變：拜占庭與保加爾聯軍合圍都羅斯托倫，切斷糧道，圍城自夏季拖到糧盡，斯維亞托斯拉夫在城內接受和約。卡面秦連弩的守城邏輯正對應這一役的兩端——攻城方靠人海與封鎖逼近城牆，守城方靠弩砲與投石把人壓在牆外。
tacticsEn: The campaign of 967 was a textbook two-pronged attack. The Byzantine navy left the Black Sea and worked north up the Danube, using the ram and the boarding capacity of the dromons against Bulgaria's river traffic; the Rus' host came down the Dnieper from Kiev, crossed the Danube and drove overland straight for Preslav, the two arms meeting beneath the capital. The Rus' method was consistently that of speed and suddenness: masses of men closed on the city at once, siege was carried out by blockade rather than by engines, supply was taken from the country as they went, and they campaigned even in winter, wanting only to reach the objective before their food ran out. In 968, when he ringed Thessalonica, he pushed this to the limit: the army first closed the city and the roads around it, then he tried to induce the governor to sell the place for a price of money, and when that failed he settled down to a long blockade and waited for hunger to do the work inside. In 969 the Byzantines counterattacked, lifting the siege of Thessalonica by sea and land together and then pursuing with a combined column of heavy cavalry, spearmen and archers as far as the gates of Preslav, where the Rus' suffered heavily. In 970 the Rus' changed to harassment and to taking point positions one by one, seizing the fortresses of the lower Danube and regaining the initiative. In 971 the situation turned again: a Byzantine-Bulgarian league closed in on Dorostolon, cut the supply line and dragged the siege out from summer until the food ran out, and Sviatoslav accepted a treaty inside the town. The defensive logic of the card's repeating crossbow matches the two ends of this one campaign, the besiegers pressing on the walls with masses of men and blockade, the besieged keeping them pinned outside by bolt-throwers and stone.
data: 能核對的時間點很清楚：965年羅斯攻取可薩要衝別拉亞韋沙，966到967年有沿第聶伯河出海、進入裏海劫掠的遠征；967年夏，拜占庭艦隊溯多瑙河、羅斯軍攻陷普雷斯拉夫；968到969年羅斯圍塞薩洛尼基，969年拜占庭解圍並在普雷斯拉夫城下取勝；970年羅斯攻擊多瑙河下游諸堡；971年夏秋都羅斯托倫圍城與議和；972年春斯維亞托斯拉夫死於第聶伯河險灘。整場戰爭自967年夏至971年秋，歷時約四年。兵員數字最不可靠：拜占庭史家形容羅斯軍「無數」，常被引用的十萬、八萬之類都屬後人推估；史料記載的拜占庭遠征艦隊規模約三百艘。普雷斯拉夫圍城只延續了很短的時間，有編年史記為三日；都羅斯托倫的圍城則自夏季拖到糧盡。斯維亞托斯拉夫撤退時所乘舟船，據載只餘六十艘上下；他留在第聶伯河上的大批舟船多達數千艘，隨後被拜占庭遠征軍溯河燒毀。地理上，基輔到普雷斯拉夫的直線距離約一千公里，第聶伯河全長約二千二百公里，多瑙河約二千八百六十公里，而羅斯軍隊在967年最遠推進到距基輔近千公里之外作戰。
dataEn: The points that can be fixed chronologically are clear. In 965 the Rus' took the Khazar stronghold of Sarkel; in 966 and 967 they made an expedition down the Dnieper to the sea and into the Caspian to raid its shores. In the summer of 967 the Byzantine squadron came up the Danube and the Rus' army took Preslav. From 968 to 969 the Rus' besieged Thessalonica, and in 969 Byzantium relieved it and won a battle at the gates of Preslav. In 970 the Rus' attacked the fortresses of the lower Danube; in the summer and autumn of 971 Dorostolon was besieged and a treaty was made; and in the spring of 972 Sviatoslav was killed in the Dnieper rapids. The whole war, from the summer of 967 to the autumn of 971, lasted about four years. Headcounts are the least reliable thing here: the Byzantine chroniclers describe the Rus' host as innumerable, and the figures of a hundred thousand or eighty thousand that are so often quoted are later reconstructions; the size of the Byzantine expeditionary squadron is given in the sources at about three hundred ships. The siege of Preslav lasted a very short time, one chronicle giving three days, while the siege of Dorostolon dragged from summer until the food was gone. The ships in which Sviatoslav left are said to have numbered some sixty; the great number of craft he left on the Dnieper ran to thousands, and they were burnt by the Byzantine expedition that went up the river after him. Geographically, the straight line from Kiev to Preslav is about a thousand kilometres, the Dnieper runs for about two thousand two hundred kilometres and the Danube for about two thousand eight hundred and sixty, and the Rus' army in 967 campaigned as much as a thousand kilometres from its own base.
cause: 直接起因是保加利亞的財富對草原劫掠者的吸引力，加上拜占庭需要一個能打陸戰的外援來對付保加利亞。965年拜占庭曾自色雷斯攻入保加爾、攻陷普雷斯拉夫與塞爾迪卡，卻因北方匈牙利人劫掠色雷斯而被迫回撤；967年尼基弗洛斯二世再試，改為借羅斯之力。斯維亞托斯拉夫願意出兵，條件是錢：他要求拜占庭支付酬金，記錄這次交易的福卡斯功績錄寫得毫不含糊，皇帝則拒絕，並回信列數羅斯歷年在拜占庭得到的庇護與牧師。對羅斯而言，這是一筆算得清的生意：965年可薩已滅，草原門戶打開，南方卻仍被拜占庭視為禁區，羅斯人既想做馬其頓與保加利亞那樣的征服者，就得先取得南下的資本與盟友；而保加爾內部的宮廷鬥爭、教會與世俗權力的衝突，以及首都禁軍對沙皇的疑心，都讓這個國家看起來比實際更脆弱。至於968年之後戰爭性質改變，則是因為拜占庭解決了保加爾的威脅，轉而要收拾這個不聽話的傭兵。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the attraction of Bulgarian wealth to the steppe raiders, combined with Byzantium's need of a land power to deal with Bulgaria. In 965 the Byzantines had entered Bulgaria from Thrace, taken Preslav and Serdica, and then been forced to withdraw when the Magyars raided Thrace from the north; in 967 Nikephoros II tried again and this time took the Rus' into the bargain. Sviatoslav was willing to march, and the price was money: he demanded payment from the emperor, the Deeds of Nikephoros Phokas states the terms of the bargain without evasion, and the emperor refused, replying with a letter that enumerated the protection and the missionaries the Rus' had received from Byzantium over the years. For the Rus' this was a transaction that could be calculated. With the Khazars destroyed in 965 the steppe gateway stood open, but the south was still a forbidden zone in Byzantine eyes, and if the Rus' were to play the part of conquerors like the Macedonians and the Bulgarians themselves, they needed capital and an ally to move south with. Inside Bulgaria, struggles at court, the friction between church and lay authority, and the suspicion of the tsar held by the garrison of the capital all made the country look far weaker than it was. As for the change in the character of the war after 968, that came when Byzantium had removed the Bulgarian danger and turned instead to settling the account with an unruly mercenary.
impact: 這場戰爭把三方的格局重新排定。保加利亞的獨立得以延續到1018年，但它在971年的和約中割讓多瑙河下游大片土地，處境從一個帝國降為帝國的附庸；867年以來爭取到的教會自主權與870年確立的教區自治卻保住了，博里斯二世於972年即位，普雷斯拉夫文學院仍維持到該世紀末，成了「金色傳奇」的尾聲。羅斯方面的代價最重：斯維亞托斯拉夫本人死於回師途中，第聶伯河上的舟船被焚，基輔失去了這一代最成功的征服者，南方擴張中止；但羅斯人也在這幾年裡第一次以常備軍與海陸兩用的姿態出現在多瑙河，隨後便走上受洗之路，988年弗拉基米爾的洗禮把羅斯與拜占庭從敵對改成同盟。拜占庭則拿回多瑙河下游的整條邊界，並在972年之後連續用兵把保加爾全境收入版圖，10世紀末到11世紀初的這段擴張，正是由福卡斯與齊米斯凱斯兩位軍事皇帝開的頭。
impactEn: The war rearranged the balance between the three parties. Bulgarian independence survived until 1018, but the treaty of 971 cost it large tracts of the lower Danube and left it a dependency rather than an empire; the ecclesiastical autonomy it had won since 867 and the autocephaly of the Bulgarian church confirmed in 870 were preserved, Boris II took the throne in 972, and the Preslav Literary School ran on to the end of the century as the last flourish of the golden age. The price was heaviest for the Rus': Sviatoslav himself was killed on the road home, the boats on the Dnieper were burnt, and Kiev lost the most successful conqueror of that generation, so that the southern expansion was checked. Yet these were the years in which the Rus' appeared on the Danube for the first time as a standing army able to operate by sea and by land, and they led straight to the road of baptism: the baptism of Vladimir in 988 turned Rus' and Byzantium from enemies into allies. Byzantium, for its part, recovered the whole lower Danube frontier, and after 972 marched in again to bring the whole of Bulgaria within the empire, so that the expansion of the late tenth and early eleventh centuries was opened by the two soldier emperors Nikephoros and Tzimiskes.
result: 967年的結局是保加利亞首都陷落：普雷斯拉夫開城，斯維亞托斯拉夫取得財富與戰利品，博里斯二世出逃，羅斯一度以為自己可以兼併這個國家。但形勢在兩年內逆轉——969年塞薩洛尼基解圍、普雷斯拉夫城下那場敗仗，使羅斯的進攻從攻勢變成守勢；970年雖然奪下多瑙河下游一系列堡壘，971年在都羅斯托倫卻被拜占庭與保加爾聯軍合圍，糧道斷絕、炎暑耗盡存糧，最後只能割地、納貢、以子女為質。972年早春他乘殘餘的六十艘左右船隻順流而下，回到基輔途中在第聶伯河險灘被佩切涅格人伏擊身亡；拜占庭遠征軍則溯第聶伯河而上，燒毀羅斯留在河上的舟船。長期看，羅斯退守草原，保加爾苟延，帝國在多瑙河下游的邊界就此固定，三方關係回到羅斯與拜占庭聯手對付保加爾的新局。兵器史上這場戰爭並未改變東歐的譜系，羅斯人仍以斧、矛、複合弓與平底船作戰，卻也留下了一份最清楚的攻城教材：圍城者靠封鎖與飢餓，逼守城者以弩砲、投石與城牆厚度來比誰先耗盡。
resultEn: The outcome of 967 was the fall of the Bulgarian capital: Preslav opened its gates, Sviatoslav took the treasure and the spoil, Boris II fled abroad, and the Rus' for a time believed they could annex the country. But the situation reversed within two years. The relief of Thessalonica in 969 and the defeat at the gates of Preslav turned the Rus' offensive into a defensive one; although they seized a series of fortresses on the lower Danube in 970, in 971 they were surrounded at Dorostolon by the combined Byzantine and Bulgarian armies, the supply line was cut, the summer heat wore out the remaining food, and the end of it was territorial cession, tribute and hostages given from his own family. In the early spring of 972 he went down the river in the sixty-odd ships that were left, and was killed by Pechenegs in the Dnieper rapids on the way back to Kiev, while the Byzantine expedition went up the Dnieper and burnt the Rus' craft left on the river. In the long run the Rus' fell back to the steppe, Bulgaria survived, and the imperial frontier on the lower Danube was fixed where it stood; the three-way relation returned to its new pattern, with Rus' and Byzantium combining against Bulgaria. In the history of arms this war changed nothing in the eastern spectrum, for the Rus' still fought with axe, spear, composite bow and flat-bottomed boat, but it did leave behind one of the clearest manuals of siege work: the besieger with blockade and hunger, the besieged with bolt-throwers, stone and the thickness of the wall, each waiting to see who was exhausted first.
